description: Implementation of the LocalGrainDirectory class responsible for managing grain directory information locally within an Orleans silo. It handles registration, lookup, cache management, silo membership changes, and directory partitioning logic.

classes.name: LocalGrainDirectory
classes.description: Manages local grain directory state, registration, deregistration, lookup, and membership within an Orleans silo.

classes.name: DirectoryMembership
classes.description: Represents the list of silo members and cached silos for the directory, with default empty static instance.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the local grain directory service, sets the Running flag, subscribes to silo status events.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops directory processing, clears directory partition and cache, sets Running to false.

methods.name: AddServer
methods.description: Adds a new silo to the membership ring and cache, reorders, processes handoff, and adjusts local directory and cache.

methods.name: RemoveServer
methods.description: Removes a silo from membership, notifies catalog, adjusts local directory and cache.

methods.name: CalculateGrainDirectoryPartition
methods.description: Determines the owning silo for a given grain ID based on consistent hashing.

methods.name: CheckIfShouldForward
methods.description: Decides if a request should be forwarded to another silo based on ownership and hop limit.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous lookup for a grain's address, with forwarding if necessary.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation, forwarding to owner silo if needed.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a grain activation, forwarding to owner if necessary.

methods.name: InvalidateCacheEntry
methods.description: Removes a cache entry for a grain ID or activation address.
